left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Patients aged 18-74, receiving therapy for active ulcerative colitis  [AND] confirmed by Mayo Score assessment, and evidence of colonic inflammation

Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Evidence of Crohn's disease, [OR]  indeterminate colitis, [OR]  or presence of bacterial  [OR] or parasitic infection

right.raw_text: -  Patients receiving biologic agents  [OR] and experimental agents are excluded
